title: Minimal-Degree Foliations on Cominuscule Grassmannians
summary: Given $X$ a cominuscule Grassmannian (or irreducible Hermitian symmetric space) and an integer $p,$ we compute the minimum $l(p)$ such that $H^0 (Ω^p_X (l(p)))$ is not 0. This allows us to conclude that any codimension-one foliation of degree zero on a cominuscule Grassmannian is a pencil of hyperplanes, improving a result of the first and third authors with D. Faenzi. We also deduce the structure of codimension-one foliations of degree one.
